title: Zork-Inspired: Beneath Hollow Hill
public_details: An original text-adventure homage: explore a forgotten hill house, uncover hidden routes, solve mechanical puzzles, and return its lost relics to the entry hall.
initial_objective: Explore the hill house and discover the assignment left for the first visitor.
objective: Find the sun medallion, moss seal and copper bell, then return to the entry hall and put all three relics on its floor.
opening_narrative: The hill door closes behind you with a patient click. In the entry hall, a tarnished lantern waits beside a visitor ledger. Three empty hooks have left pale outlines on the wall, and passages descend beneath the house.

body.description: A resourceful explorer with hands and a practical satchel that can carry five inventory units.

entry-hall.name: Entry hall
entry-hall.description: A circular hall beneath Hollow Hill. A visitor ledger rests below three empty relic hooks. The northern arch leads into the house; this is where every recovered relic must be put down.

crossed-gallery.name: Crossed gallery
crossed-gallery.description: Four passages meet beneath worn stone beams: a study to the east, a workshop to the west, and an iron stair descending south. The entry hall lies north.

quiet-study.name: Quiet study
quiet-study.description: Dusty instruments surround an old bookcase. A shallow lens drawer is closed beneath the desk, and the bookcase may conceal more than books.

old-workshop.name: Old workshop
old-workshop.description: A workbench holds a coil of climbing rope. A stout green chest is locked with an ordinary brass key.

iron-stair.name: Iron stair
iron-stair.description: The stair ends beside a collapsed crossing. A winch can pull a narrow bridge across the gap, if it is rigged with sound rope. The gallery remains above.

sun-chamber.name: Sun chamber
sun-chamber.description: A white chamber contains an astronomical dial and a sealed reliquary. Fine brass lines converge on a missing lens.

root-cellar.name: Root cellar
root-cellar.description: Stone roots curl through the walls. A round bell case waits beyond the recovered bridge.

hall-arch.name: Northern arch
hall-arch.description: An open arch connects the entry hall and crossed gallery.

study-door.name: Study doorway
study-door.description: A narrow doorway leads east into the quiet study.

workshop-door.name: Workshop doorway
workshop-door.description: A low doorway leads west into the old workshop.

cellar-door.name: Iron cellar door
cellar-door.description: A locked iron door leads down to the iron stair. Its brass lock matches the key in the entry hall.

bookcase-stair.name: Bookcase stair
bookcase-stair.description: A steep concealed stair rises from behind the bookcase to the sun chamber.

recovered-bridge.name: Recovered bridge
recovered-bridge.description: A winched bridge spans the gap from the iron stair to the root cellar. Rope must be fitted to the winch before it can be lowered.

visitor-ledger.name: Visitor ledger
visitor-ledger.description: A ledger left open to the latest assignment.
visitor-ledger.readable_text: To whoever follows the old survey marks: recover the sun medallion, moss seal and copper bell. Bring each intact relic to this hall and put it down beneath its hook. Carrying them here is not enough.

tarnished-lantern.name: Tarnished lantern
tarnished-lantern.description: A small lantern with a steady blue flame. It makes the stone passages feel less empty.

brass-key.name: Brass house key
brass-key.description: A long brass key hanging from the central hook.

cellar-lock.name: Cellar lock
cellar-lock.description: A broad brass lock set into the iron cellar door.

lens-drawer.name: Lens drawer
lens-drawer.description: A shallow wooden drawer beneath the study desk.

glass-lens.name: Ground glass lens
glass-lens.description: A precisely ground lens that fits the astronomical dial in the sun chamber.

ancient-bookcase.name: Ancient bookcase
ancient-bookcase.description: A tall bookcase whose base sits slightly away from the wall. Searching it might reveal a concealed route.

astral-dial.name: Astronomical dial
astral-dial.description: A brass mechanism that accepts the study's glass lens and can release the sun reliquary when correctly aligned.

sun-reliquary.name: Sun reliquary
sun-reliquary.description: A white stone casket held shut by interlocking brass teeth.

sun-medallion.name: Sun medallion
sun-medallion.description: A bright medallion engraved with a compass rose: one of the three lost relics.

green-chest.name: Green work chest
green-chest.description: A sturdy chest fitted with a brass lock.

chest-lock.name: Work chest lock
chest-lock.description: A small brass lock that matches the house key.

climbing-rope.name: Climbing rope
climbing-rope.description: A sound coil of rope suitable for rigging the collapsed crossing's winch.

moss-seal.name: Moss seal
moss-seal.description: A square green seal cut from translucent stone: one of the three lost relics.

bridge-winch.name: Bridge winch
bridge-winch.description: A mechanism for fitting rope and lowering the bridge to the root cellar.

bell-case.name: Bell case
bell-case.description: A circular case resting among the stone roots.

copper-bell.name: Copper bell
copper-bell.description: A small copper bell with no clapper visible: one of the three lost relics.

skill_challenges.description: Fit the glass lens to the astronomical dial and align its brass lines to release the sun reliquary.
Rig the climbing rope through the winch and lower the bridge across the collapsed crossing.
